target: measured treated-condition mean minus matched cell-line control mean
selection_metric: validation delta-expression mean squared error pooled across condition-gene pairs

condition_id_normalization.cell_line: trim ends and replace CVCL_ with CVCL-
condition_id_normalization.drug: trim ends and replace DMSO_TF with DMSO-TF while preserving meaningful internal spaces
condition_id_normalization.match_rule: exact one-to-one manifest matching after normalization; fail on unmatched or duplicated IDs

split.final_fit: candidate models are fitted on all 29277 internal-training conditions
split.formal_validation: the unchanged 3252 conditions are used for hyperparameter and checkpoint selection
split.external_test_access: prohibited until both final MLP and RF model records are frozen

random_forest.matched_control_feature_selection: highest variance across internal-training condition control profiles only
random_forest.categorical_encoding: one-hot fitted on internal training conditions only
